one_liner: The sweeper is thrown to put hitters away, not to catch up: 36.9% of sweepers in 2025 came with the pitcher ahead in the count, only 18.7% when behind.
three_things: A putaway-leaning breaker: 36.9% ahead, 18.7% behind, 44.4% even.
The slowest of the four pitches profiled here: median 82.7 mph across 52,681 thrown (7.6% of all pitches).
It nearly vanishes on 3-0 (0.09%) and concentrates in two-strike counts like 0-2 (9.58%).
context_note: Descriptive only, over a single 2025 Statcast pull. The count shares are of this pitch's OWN usage (what share of sweepers fall in each count/leverage class), not the share of any count that is a sweeper. The strike bucket merges called, swinging, and foul strikes (no per-pitch swing/take in this corpus), so it is not a whiff rate. 'Slowest of these four' is scoped to the four pitch types written up in this pack. Not a prediction; no edge claim.
